question: Who among the following cricketers won the orange cap in IPL 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ruturaj Gaikwad.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2021, **Ruturaj Gaikwad** became the first uncapped Indian player to win the Orange Cap.
 
• The Chennai Super Kings opener **smacked 635 runs in 16 matches**, **striking at 136.27 with an average of 45.36. Consequently, CSK also managed to win the title in 2021.**
 
• **Jos Buttler** wins the Orange Cap with **863 runs in 2022**.
 
• He is followed by **KL Rahul, Quinton De Kock, Hardik Pandya, and Shubman Gill.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Venkatesh was the revelation of IPL 2021, where he scored 370 runs in 10 innings at a strike rate of 128.47 for Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) in the second phase of IPL 2021.
 
• The fast bowler, Harshal Patel, won the Purple Cap in the 2021 edition of the league with 32 wickets 
 
• In IPL 2021, KL Rahul amassed **616 runs in 13 matches**.**​**
